reconciliationPolicy.rule: Accept and use reported data when an arithmetic reconciliation difference is <= 10 million VND; do not alter source values to force reconciliation. Differences > 10 million VND require review. Missing source pages or insufficient period basis remain unresolved regardless of this tolerance.
